home.infoDetails.terms.title: Terms of Service
home.infoDetails.terms.content:
By accessing or using BetoGo, you agree to be bound by these Terms of Service. Please read them carefully before using our platform.

Eligibility

By using the platform, you confirm that online gaming is permitted in your jurisdiction.

Game Fairness

All games are powered by certified third-party providers using RNG technology that has been independently audited. BetoGo does not manipulate game outcomes. Winnings are subject to applicable wagering requirements.

Transactions

Deposits and withdrawals are processed via secure payment channels. Processing times may vary. BetoGo is not liable for delays caused by third-party payment processors. All transactions are monitored for security purposes.

Account Security

You are responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of your account credentials. BetoGo reserves the right to verify player identity and freeze suspicious accounts. Multiple accounts per player are prohibited.

Wagering & Withdrawal Requirements

All deposits are subject to a 1x wagering requirement before any withdrawal may be processed. This means you must wager an amount equal to your deposit before withdrawing. For example, a ₱1,000 deposit requires ₱1,000 in total wagers. The requirement applies to each deposit independently and is tracked automatically. Your wagering progress is displayed in the withdrawal tab of your wallet.

These terms may be updated at any time. Continued use of the platform constitutes acceptance of the latest terms.
home.infoDetails.privacy.title: Privacy Policy
home.infoDetails.privacy.content:
BetoGo collects only information necessary to operate the platform. This includes your Telegram user ID, display name, and profile photo provided by Telegram upon login. We may also collect device information and IP address for fraud prevention and security purposes.

How We Use Your Data

Your data is used solely for account management, identity verification, transaction processing, and platform security. We do not sell, rent, or share your personal data with third parties for marketing purposes.

Data Retention

Transaction records and account history are retained for a minimum of 5 years for compliance and security purposes. You may request deletion of non-essential data by contacting our support team.

Data Security

We use TLS encryption for all data in transit and AES-256 encryption for data at rest. Our infrastructure adheres to international security standards. Access to user data is restricted to authorized personnel only.

Contact

For privacy concerns, reach out to our support team via live chat. We will respond within 3 business days.
home.infoDetails.responsible.title: Responsible Gaming
home.infoDetails.responsible.content:
BetoGo is committed to responsible gaming in line with international responsible gaming standards. Gambling should be entertainment — never a source of income or an escape from problems. We actively promote responsible gambling practices across our platform.

Player Protection Tools

• Deposit Limits — Set daily/weekly/monthly deposit caps
• Session Time Reminders — Get notified when you have played for extended periods
• Self-Exclusion — Temporarily or permanently exclude yourself from the platform
• Reality Check — Regular pop-ups showing your session time and spend

Problem Gambling Help

If gambling is negatively affecting your life, please reach out:
• BetoGo 24/7 Support — Available via live chat
• Gamblers Anonymous — www.gamblersanonymous.org

You are never alone. Help is always available. Play responsibly.

team.guide.title: 3-Circle Rewards
team.guide.content:
What are 3 circles

Share your invite link and grow rewards through three circles. Circle 1 is friends you invite directly. Circle 2 is friends invited by Circle 1. Circle 3 is one more circle beyond that. Rewards are based on valid bet amounts only (wins/losses are not deducted). Multi-currency bets are converted to PHP equivalent at the daily FX rate.

Circle structure

C1: Friends you invited directly
C2: Friends invited by your C1 members
C3: Friends invited by your C2 members
The C1 / C2 / C3 counts at the top show your current circle size.

Reward rates

C1 reward = member's monthly valid bets (PHP equiv.) × {{l1Rate}}%
C2 reward = member's monthly valid bets (PHP equiv.) × {{l2Rate}}%
C3 reward = member's monthly valid bets (PHP equiv.) × {{l3Rate}}%
Rates shown on this page apply to your account.

Circle activation

A circle member must make a first deposit of at least ₱100 and become activated before their bets generate rewards. Bets from inactive members do not generate rewards (same-day qualifying bets may still appear in the circle tree for reference). Bets funded by free bonuses (red packets, spins, task rewards, etc.) and turnover from members who have never deposited are excluded from the reward base.

Qualified bets & settlement

Valid bets: only settled bet orders count; win payouts are not subtracted.
Multi-currency: PHP, USDT, USDC, etc. are tracked separately and converted to PHP for rewards.
Circle tree bets: past days use daily snapshots; today's bets update in real time.
Reward settlement: runs daily (Philippines time) for the previous day's bets. After settlement, rewards appear under Circle Rewards and your withdrawable balance.

Viewing & withdrawal

Circle Rewards: browse monthly C1/C2/C3 totals and details; switch between tree and list views.
Withdraw: submit a request on the Withdraw tab. Minimum amount is shown on the page. Review usually takes 1–3 business days.

Notes

Always share your official invite link so circle members are attributed correctly.
Rewards are credited in PHP equivalent regardless of which currency your circle members play with.
Contact live support if you have questions.

profile.docDetails.aml.title: AML Policy
profile.docDetails.aml.content:
BetoGo is committed to preventing money laundering and terrorist financing in full compliance with applicable regulations and international anti-money laundering standards.

Know Your Customer (KYC)

We verify player identities through Telegram and Google authentication. For higher withdrawal amounts or when suspicious activity is detected, additional documentation may be required. Identity verification ensures the integrity of our platform for all players.

Transaction Monitoring

All financial transactions are continuously monitored for unusual patterns. Deposits and withdrawals are screened against international sanctions lists and risk indicators. Our compliance team investigates flagged activities promptly.

Reporting Obligations

BetoGo cooperates fully with relevant regulators and law enforcement authorities. Suspicious transactions are reported in accordance with applicable anti-money laundering laws. We maintain detailed transaction records as required by regulation.

Player Responsibilities

Players must ensure all funds used for gaming are from legitimate sources. Using the platform for money laundering or any illegal financial activity is strictly prohibited and will result in immediate account suspension and reporting to authorities.

Contact Compliance

For AML-related queries or to report suspicious activity, contact our support team via live chat. All reports are treated with strict confidentiality.
profile.docDetails.bonusTerms.title: Bonus Terms
profile.docDetails.bonusTerms.content:
All bonuses and promotional offers on BetoGo are subject to the following terms and conditions. By claiming any bonus, you agree to these terms.

Eligibility

Bonuses are available to registered players who meet the eligibility criteria specified for each promotion. Some bonuses are restricted to new players, first deposits, or specific activities as described in the promotion details.

Welcome Bonus

New players may receive free bonus credits upon registration with no deposit required. This bonus is credited automatically to eligible accounts and is intended for exploring the platform without financial risk.

First Deposit Bonus

A deposit match bonus is available on qualifying first deposits. The bonus percentage and maximum bonus amount are as stated in the active promotion. A minimum deposit amount applies to qualify.

Referral Bonus

Players who invite friends may receive a bonus when the referred player completes their first qualifying deposit. Both the referrer and the referee may receive bonuses as specified in the current promotion.

Wagering Requirements

All bonuses are subject to wagering requirements before any withdrawal can be made. The required wagering multiplier is specified per promotion. Wagering must be completed within the stated time limit.

General Rules

• One bonus per player, per household, per IP address unless stated otherwise
• BetoGo reserves the right to modify or withdraw any promotion at any time
• Abuse of bonus offers will result in account suspension
• In case of any dispute, BetoGo's decision is final
• All bonuses are subject to BetoGo's full Terms of Service
